title: The fixed setting
statement:
Work with the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, $\ell$, $E$, $\Oe$,
$\varpi_E$, $\AEn=\Oe/\varpi_E^n$ and the coefficient stages
$\Lambda\in\{\AEn,\Oe,E,\Qlb\}$ fixed in [sk-def-sf-setting]. Let $X_0/k_0$ be smooth of relative
dimension $d$, separated of finite type and geometrically connected, put
$X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\Spec k$, and let $a_X:X\to s$ be the
structure morphism. No admissibility hypothesis is imposed on $a_X$: its
exceptional inverse image $Ra_X^!$ is the constructible exceptional adjoint
of [sk-def-sf-operations](vi), which exists and preserves $\Dctf$ at every
stage for every separated finite-type morphism ([sk-prop-sf-existence],
[thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class], [sk-prop-sf-rf-shriek-preservation],
[thm-sf-ctf-stability]); the ambient datum of [sk-def-sf-admissible] is not
used (its full-cohomological-dimension requirement fails for smooth proper
curves). Properness of $X_0$ is *not* part of this setting: the duality
statements are formulated with compact supports and do not use it. It is
imposed explicitly only in the later trace, Poincare-duality, and
derived-duality constructions, where an identification
$Ra_{X!}\cong Ra_{X*}$ is needed.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q79-398281534 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read in full: the item sk-def-set, the unit record, the main-20261015 _section.md (order 2748) and the master unit text. The statement matches the current source clause by clause: the finite-field datum and four coefficient stages, X_0 smooth of relative dimension d, separated, finite type and geometrically connected, the base change X = X_0 x_{k_0} k, no admissibility hypothesis, and properness excluded. Ra_X^! is sk-def-sf-operations (vi), which is defined for every separated finite-type morphism; a_X qualifies. Its adjunction is thm-sf-ambient-adjoint-class (2) on the etale-origin class at the finite stage, and preservation of D^b_ctf is thm-sf-ctf-stability (v) at the finite stage and (vii) at the other stages. The replacement sk-thm-sf-ctf-stability -> thm-sf-ctf-stability is correct, since that node carries the unit. The forward references to downstream duality nodes were rightly turned into prose. A reachability check over stmt_deps and proof_deps shows no dependency reaches sk-def-set, so the imported in_cycle flag is resolved. The report prose about removing operation references is inconsistent with the final file, which keeps sk-def-sf-operations, but the files are acyclic. The item is a definition with no proof steps and the delivery creates no new nodes. The slopmaster2 declaration AlgebraicGeometry.PoincareDualitySetting (lines 75-82) is geometry-only and its docstring says it omits the coefficient datum, so not attaching it is correct. Duplicate candidate def-pod-conventions (sec-six-functors) is not the same statement: it assumes admissibility and adds orientation, duals and Frobenius. same_as [] is defensible; the conflict between the two nodes is noted for the maintainer. Edge cases checked: d=0 gives X=Spec k and a_X=id; empty X_0 is excluded by connectedness; nonproper A^1 is allowed; all four stages are covered. The parenthetical 'fails for smooth proper curves' is the source's own wording and is supported by the elliptic-curve warning. No SGA source is cited, no fixes were made, no tool_uses.
